blink.label: Blink
blink.prompt: the person blinks naturally twice, otherwise perfectly still, looking at the camera

glance.label: Glance
glance.prompt: the person's eyes glance to the left, then to the right, then back to the camera, head still

look-around.label: Look around
look-around.prompt: the person slowly turns their head slightly left, then right, looking around curiously, then back to the camera

smile.label: Smile
smile.prompt: the person breaks into a warm natural smile, then relaxes back to neutral

nod.label: Nod
nod.prompt: the person gives a small friendly nod and returns to neutral

hair-breeze.label: Hair in the breeze
hair-breeze.prompt: a gentle breeze moves the person's hair softly, the person stays still and looks at the camera
